title: Replay trash record
description: `<replay id>/trash.json`: present once the replay was deleted (`DELETE /api/replays/<id>`). The replay is out of every list and its bundle answers 404; `POST /api/replays/<id>/restore` removes the record within the trash window (7 days), after which the retention sweep deletes the replay. Source of truth: src/shared/schemas/replay-meta.ts.
